verdict.rationale: TrueLayer's first-party docs describe payment mandates created specifically to set up recurring payments. Mandates come in three types: Sweeping VRPs, Wave 1 VRPs and Direct Debits. Once a user authorises a mandate, payments created on it execute immediately with no further authorisation, which covers VRP, standing-consent and recurring-debit flows. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of mandate/VRP flows in production, and detail on mandate limits and constraints management.
